svg.title: Build a research brief you can check
svg.desc: A research tool gathers sources for a question. You decide whether each source supports the resulting claim. Set the question. Name the subject, scope and sources you need. Gather. Review the plan where offered, then inspect the sources found. Verify. Open a cited page and find the sentence that supports each important claim.
